name: SQLite MCP Sidecar
tagline: Guarded agent access to a live SQLite database
description: A self-hosted MCP sidecar (Docker, Streamable HTTP) for one SQLite database that another application owns. Read-only by default; structured writes need a filter and a row limit that counts cascades; DDL, ATTACH and PRAGMA are blocked by the SQLite authorizer; online backups. Run the container first (see the README), then install with the URL and token of your deployment.
